new_factory_source:
"""Shared file selection without the Windows shell's deferred-launch race."""

from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QFileDialog, QWidget


def file_dialog(parent: QWidget, title: str, directory: str = "") -> QFileDialog:
    dialog = QFileDialog(parent, title, directory)
    # Set before configuring/showing: immediate reject must cancel all UI work.
    dialog.setOption(QFileDialog.Option.DontUseNativeDialog)
    return dialog
